title: Why Fans Think Rory Gibson's Michael Is Also Leaving General Hospital - NewsBreak
text: Rumors are swirling among General Hospital fans that Rory Gibson’s character, Michael Corinthos, may be leaving the show soon as well. This sparked after the June 11 episode, suggesting that Michael might take a drastic decision about his future if the case doesn’t go his way. In the June 11 episode of General Hospital, Michael sits down with Carly, Sonny, and Jason, where he lays out his desperation. He’s prepared to flee the country with Wiley and Amelia if he loses custody. The custody trial has reached a breaking point, with Michael feeling cornered by what he views as betrayal from both Willow and Drew. He accuses Drew of using Wiley as a pawn and claims that Willow, blinded by trust, is putting the children at risk. Michael’s declaration to leave the country isn’t just emotional, it’s definitive. He says he’s out of time and doesn’t believe his kids are safe under Willow’s care. Even Carly pleads with him not to make such a drastic move, reminding him he’ll become a fugitive. Michael doesn’t budge. That moment has fans wondering: Is Rory Gibson’s Michael also leaving General Hospital? Adding more weight to this theory is his decision to stay out of Daisy’s life. He tells Carly that Sasha now has her own family and that he promised to let her raise Daisy on her terms. While he says he will never regret having Daisy, he believes the truth about her could cost him Wiley and Amelia. Later, Michael takes the kids to the park and runs into Willow. Their conversation turns cold as she tells him things didn’t have to turn out this way. Michael shoots back, saying she was the one who made that choice. Then both receive a court alert, likely the judge’s ruling. The moment has left fans bracing for what’s gonna come next.
